headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: SAI (7)

summary: Lando Norris won the Miami Grand Prix Sprint from P3 on the grid, 0.7s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium.
Yuki Tsunoda made the biggest climb, from P20 to P6.
Max Verstappen had a day to forget, dropping from P4 to P17.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag and 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised VER (10 second time penalty).
There were 20 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 9 points over Lando Norris.
